{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales_clean = sales[~sales['revenue_clean'].eq(999999.99)]

# Recompute converted: 1 only if status == 'completed'
sales_clean['converted_correct'] = (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Check the corrected conversion rate by channel
print("Corrected conversion rate by channel:")
print(sales_clean.groupby('channel')['converted_correct'].mean())

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
diff_rate = sales_clean.groupby('channel')['converted_correct'].mean().loc['email'] - \
            sales_clean.groupby('channel')['converted_correct'].mean().loc['paid_search']

print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {diff_rate}")"}
